page: Google Cloud Platform a3-ultragpu-8g is an accelerator-optimized server featuring eight NVIDIA Hopper H200 GPUs with a total of 1128 GB of VRAM. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8581C processor providing 224 dedicated vCPUs across 112 physical cores, operating at 2.1 GHz. The system is equipped with 2952.0 GB of system memory, translating to 13.18 GB per core, and includes 12599 GB of local NVMe SSD storage.

Benchmark results place this server in the top tier for multi-core CPU performance, memory bandwidth, and multi-threaded decompression. It also achieves top-tier status in Passmark CPU tests, including extended instructions, encryption, and physics. While single-core CPU performance and Passmark memory scores fall into the average category, the server excels in specialized workloads, demonstrating top-tier performance in LLM inference prompt processing for both small and medium models, as well as text generation for medium models.

Given its massive resource density, including eight high-end GPUs and substantial NVMe storage, this server represents a highly specialized hardware class. The qualitative cost efficiency is aligned with large-scale parallel processing and deep learning workloads where resource density minimizes inter-node communication overhead. However, the tradeoff includes average single-core performance, indicating that workloads relying on single-threaded execution will not fully leverage the hardware's premium capabilities.

The a3-ultragpu-8g is designed for demanding workloads such as large language model training and inference, high-performance computing, ray tracing, and large-scale database operations. The combination of high-capacity local NVMe SSDs and massive GPU memory makes it suitable for data-intensive AI pipelines, complex simulations, and high-throughput data processing.
